NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author pushed twice. They reworded all three commit messages and removed an unneeded guard, which took the diff from +14 to +13 lines. The same 3 files are changed.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Commit messages were rewritten after the feedback, and the titles now read as clear "Use update_fields when…" summaries. I can't see the commit bodies in the input. |
| ✅  | The earlier request to link a discussion is done, since the CZO thread is linked. Sahil Batra said there it saw no reason to leave out `update_fields`. |
| ⚠️  | The description still has an empty "Fixes:" line, and the testing note is only "Verified no test failures". CI passed. This is minor for a change this small. |

**Reviewer:** @sahil839 — he reviewed this PR and the CZO thread, and he gave the commit-message feedback.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign sahil839.

###### Reply

```quote
@sahil839, the commit messages have been reworded and the extra guard removed. Could you take another look?
```
